summary: NXT Energy Solutions Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its 2026 Management Information Circular and Notice of Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders to be held on June 9, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: receiving audited financials, electing seven directors, appointing MNP LLP as auditor, and approving an Employee Share Purchase Plan, Unallocated Entitlements Resolution, and a Preferred Share Resolution. No special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a standard proxy circular for an annual meeting with special resolutions, not a transformative event. What to watch: shareholder approval of preferred share authorization may enable future financing flexibility.
